description: A ranked table of hotel brands from the motel.loans FDD database (48 brands): royalty plus marketing percent, per-room monthly fees, initial fee for 60 rooms, transfer fee and Item 7 total investment range, each with its FDD year and page. parent.description: Only brands of this parent company.
